content:
TEMPTATION ||| Grip the Answer tighter, leaning closer to Julian's face ||| "Maybe I did do it. Care to find out?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, releasing the blade from my grasp ||| "I'm not answering until I understand what's at stake."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet Julian's gaze, vulnerability breaking through ||| "I didn’t remember bringing this, but I wish I hadn’t."  
REVERSAL ||| Hold the Answer firmly, my stance unyielding ||| "You will answer my questions before I say anything."  
SILENCE ||| Stand still, eyes locked on Julian, breath caught ||| *mm*
